variants.title: Variants and sizes
variants.note: One row per size, one button per variant, each labelled with its variant name.

states.title: States
states.note: Each variant default, `isDisabled` and `isLoading`. A loading button refuses presses and reports busy.

icons.title: Icons
icons.note: `startIcon`, `endIcon` or both. The end icon is mirrored in right-to-left: switch to Arabic.

full_width.title: Full width
full_width.note: `isFullWidth` stretches the button to its container.

live.title: Try it
live.note: Press Save: it loads for a moment. The counter button counts presses; the disabled one does not.
